items.context: @MerlijnTrader (424.171 seguidores, en inglés): dice que $BTC acaba de romper por debajo del Rainbow Chart por primera vez y que si los $55K aguantan empieza a comprar, y si se rompen viene más dolor. Post de ~10 minutos, 2.417 vistas, 17 likes y solo 3 respuestas: noticia fresca de precio sobre el arcoíris, respondible con el post del Rainbow Chart y el índice de temperatura.
items.suggested_text:
Worth separating two things here. The Rainbow Chart isn't a law: it's a log regression fitted to past prices, with bands drawn around it. A close below the lowest band means either BTC is historically cheap, or the curve was fitted to a younger, far more volatile asset and the bands need redrawing. Probably a bit of both.

I mapped the full price history on it: 14 years, 4 halvings, from $12 to over $100,000. Valuation points the same way from a different angle: my market temperature index (MVRV, price vs. the 200-week average, drawdown from the ATH and 90-day momentum) went from 99.29 to 0.67 in 364 days.

The bigger question isn't whether $55K holds. It's whether a maturing asset should still be judged by the bands of its childhood.
